lens: Compliance editor: enforces SEO-CONTENT-GOVERNANCE.md, owner-vocabulary-rules.md and the content-clarity-audit.mjs regexes; hunts implied career, salary, promotion, funding and organisational-outcome promises. Method: all six inputs read in full; the audit's 42 banned patterns were run mechanically over every line of the three proposals (result: zero reader-facing hits in any proposal; every hit is inside an avoid-list, fix note or risk description), then every reader-facing string was read for the non-regex rules (implied outcomes, hope-as-promise, disparagement, scarcity, scholarship and HRD Corp leakage, retyped facts, the not-an-MQA-degree boundary wherever the credential or 'awarded and endorsed by CMI' appears). Scores are 1-10; total is the plain sum of the five; governanceSafety is the heaviest-weighted criterion and decides ties and the winner from this lens.

scores.notes: Fidelity: the thesis walks the owner's sentence in order (progress -> hope -> change of experience -> not the product -> not the shortcut -> right vs good -> RJTBD -> 5S -> servant leadership) and maps each term to a site device; 'the shortcut cuts' is confined to the site's own claims and to methods; deserving is limited to the programme deserving the reader's time. Governance: no regex hits in reader copy; boundary present in the hero, /executive-mba, /executive-mba-malaysia, /lp pages and the day-3 email; every money sentence names the decision-maker. Deductions: (1) the hero CTA purpose line puts 'deserves a conversation' in the same sentence as 'RM10,000.00 standard fee, scholarship assessment' (twice: hero and sampleHero), colliding with the owner rule that deserving never touches scholarship or fees and with the proposal's own avoid list; (2) /chartered-manager-malaysia lede names the CMI Certificate of Recognition without the MQA boundary; (3) /asian-business-consulting lede has 'awarded and endorsed by CMI' without the boundary; (4) every example retypes the constants as literals (and re-phrases 'across 3 scheduled sessions' as 'in 3 scheduled sessions') while its own vocabulary says 'never retyped'; (5) SME H1 promises a business state ('a business that runs on documented decisions'); (6) 'commit without putting the role at risk' is an employment-safety reassurance; (7) 'The people who did it can be met' asserts access to graduates. Conversion: the CTA purpose lines are the best conversion device of the three and it keeps CTA_LABELS.guide unchanged, but audience and curriculum H1s run 15-20 words. Localisability: from -> to maps to 'Daripada ... kepada ...' / '从...到...' and matches the owner's 'cara anda membuat keputusan berubah' pattern, and it catches the banned 'Aturkan perbualan program' constant, but long H1s balloon in Malay and the localisation section is one paragraph. Distinctiveness: before/after is the standard copywriting formula and becomes formulaic across ten pages.

Fidelity: organises the site around the owner's 'it must be RIGHT instead of the good thing; the right is the RJTBD'; hope, change of experience, 5S and servant leadership are all present; the one fidelity cost is that the device deliberately puts the good thing on the page first (hero lede sentence one, a good-thing panel on home and audience pages), which is the thing the owner says gets in the way. Governance: the only proposal with zero retyped facts (factTokens table, every number a content.ts token, rendered values quoted for review only); explicit forbiddenUses for deserving on /fees, the self-check, scholarship FAQs and HRD Corp sentences in any language; the day-14 'No commitment.' subject and the ZH 无需承诺 mirror are removed; the international intent drops 'applying'; 'the good thing' is banned as a label for any provider. Deductions: (1) the home good-thing panel renders 'A faster route' and 'A fee to minimise' as card titles, which are the speed and price hooks the site refuses; (2) reader-voice line 'Six months, no thesis: that sounds like the quick one' contradicts its own no-exam-no-thesis rule if rendered; (3) day-7 subject 'The 2026 dates still open' is availability wording other than 'Open for enquiries'; (4) malaysia_lede renders PROGRAMME_POSITIONING_SENTENCE with fee, scholarship and HRD Corp tokens but no MQA boundary; (5) abc_lede has 'awarded and endorsed by CMI' without the boundary; (6) keeps 'The outcome is applied, not just attendance.' Conversion: 'Bring one real decision. Leave with the method.' is crisp but 'the method' is undefined in the H1; the hero lede opens by listing 'Credential, fee and schedule', so a skimming reader sees the three product attributes first; the panel reads as a benefits row with confusing titles; the fees H1 ('Every other condition confirmed in writing') and the audience H1s ('Keep the role. Change how you decide in it.') are the clearest of the three. Localisability: short imperatives translate cleanly; the owner supplies 'perkara yang betul, bukan sekadar perkara yang baik' and '对的事，而不只是好的事' so the device is renderable; multilingualNotes align with the MS and ZH banned lists (sesi perbincangan program, projek amali perniagaan, 名额有限 / 须经评估 / 书面批准); 'fair questions, and they come second' is an English rhetorical turn that must be translated for meaning. Distinctiveness: honouring the reader's temptation before putting it second is a voice no competing EMBA site uses.

Fidelity: the most complete rendering of the second half of the framework (5S as the reader's ladder climbed for others, servant leadership as posture in two directions, 'deserving comes out of serving' shown not claimed); progress and hope are present as practice inside the six months but the buying motive the owner names first (progress) sits behind Service. Governance strengths: replaces the gown-and-cap hero image; keeps the 5S section away from STAGES and bars 'next rung' / 'second stage'; gates 'Roy answers, including not this route' on operational truth; FORCES restated as 'a leader can still ...' removes fear; the recognition section carries distinction plus professionalRelevance in full. Deductions: (1) /fees H1 'RM10,000.00 standard fee. Scholarships assessed individually.' puts the scholarship in a headline as a non-verbatim fragment that drops 'limited', 'selective' and 'eligible Malaysian applicants'; (2) AI lede 'You are being asked to decide on AI without a method for deciding' diagnoses the reader; (3) SME lede promises that in six months you 'build the systems, and the managers, that carry it' and the AI H1 promises 'a decision your team and customers can trust' (outcomes for the people served, which its own rule forbids); (4) /chartered-manager-malaysia lede, /asian-business-consulting lede and the shared email footer all carry the credential or 'awarded and endorsed by CMI' without the MQA boundary; (5) the comparison row extends the reference academic MBA beyond COMPARISON_SCOPE by calling it 'MQA-accredited'; (6) literals retyped throughout, including the phone number; (7) keeps 'The outcome is applied, not just attendance.'; (8) the H1 'Decide well for the people who depend on you' carries a self-flagged shaming reading and needs the A/B alternative ready. Conversion: the five-questions section is a buyer's FAQ in the order a buyer asks it and the CTA 'Get the 2026 programme guide to check the fit' is action plus purpose in one string; the 'Survival:' ... 'Service:' labels expose the owner's internal framework to the reader. Localisability: the owner has pre-approved the 5S glosses (Kelangsungan, Keselamatan, Sosial, Kejayaan, Khidmat / 生存、安全、社交、成功、服务), 'kepimpinan berkhidmat' and '仆人式领导', so its hardest terms are already settled; 'a leader can still' translates directly; it correctly says to translate 'ladder' and 'climb' as meaning; it offers '服务型领导' which the owner rule does not allow and '更好的决定' adds a comparative the English lacks. Distinctiveness: 'the ladder you climb for others' is a positioning no competing EMBA site uses.

winnerRationale: rjtbd-first and service-first tie at 38 and progress-first sits at 37; governance safety, the heaviest-weighted criterion from this lens, orders them rjtbd-first (8) > progress-first (7) > service-first (6). rjtbd-first is the only proposal an executor can implement without converting a single literal to a constant, it is the only one with explicit forbidden-uses for deserving in every language, and its lapses are concentrated in one device (the good-thing panel) and two missing boundary sentences, all listed in rejectLines with fixes. service-first's structure is the strongest conversion device but it needs the most compliance rework before it could pass review; progress-first's hero is the safest H1 of the three and is grafted below.

graftIdeas.idea: Hero H1 'From carrying the decision alone to leading it.' with the three supporting lines (live issue; 6 days / 3 sessions / coaching / faculty review / templates retained; CMI Certificate of Recognition + not-an-MQA-degree + separate optional Chartered Manager route + 'An enquiry does not commit you to enrol or pay.') as the home hero, replacing rjtbd-first's 'Credential, fee and schedule ...' lede and good-thing panel; the purpose line must drop 'deserves a conversation' (see rejectLines).

A CTA purpose line under every primary CTA naming what the guide lets the reader decide ('Review the six-month structure, published dates, RM10,000.00 standard fee, scholarship assessment and CMI recognition, then decide whether to arrange a conversation'), rendered from constants.

Keep CTA_LABELS.guide unchanged ('Get the free 2026 programme guide') rather than adding rjtbd-first's new 'Get the 2026 programme guide and check fit' label; one fewer constant change, no retired-CTA regression risk, 'free' stays once and inside the constant.
Rename curriculum stage labels 'Level 1 / 2 / 3' to 'Stage 1 / 2 / 3' so no stage label can trip or invite the Level 7 misreading.
Day-7 nurture subject 'The published 2026 dates, in one view' (replaces rjtbd-first's 'still open').

Branch the acknowledgement subject and the first clause of the protected notice on the reader's preference ('programme guide request' vs 'conversation request') and keep the second sentence verbatim; flagged for owner sign-off because the string is protected.
The editorial test for every progress sentence: could a graduate read it back and say 'that is what I did' rather than 'that is what I was promised'. Adopt as the copy-review gate.

The flag that CTA_LABELS.ms.conversation ('Aturkan perbualan program') is a banned MS non-collocation sitting outside the MS scan; resolve with the owner before any Malay rewrite reuses it, using rjtbd-first's 'sesi perbincangan program'.

Replace the gown-and-cap hero image with a working-room photograph (strategy workshop or project review); if it stays, the boundary sentence sits in the same viewport and the alt text is plainly descriptive.

Two-ladder separation rule: the 5S ordering is never rendered next to STAGES; STAGES is introduced as 'what CMI controls after the programme'; 'next rung', 'second stage' and 'fast-track' (except CMI's own named route) are barred.
FORCES restated as 'pressure; a leader can still + activity' ('AI is rewriting how work gets done; a leader can still decide what the work is for'), submitted to ABC for approval of the constant.

The five buyer questions in buying order (can the business keep running while I learn; what am I committing to and who decides; who will I work this through with; what will I have made; who is it for) as a home section, rendered as questions without exposing the 'Survival/Safety/Social/Success/Service' labels in English copy; in Malay and Chinese use the owner's glosses once if the labels are shown.

Operational-truth gate: 'the team will say plainly if the programme is not the right route' and 'Roy Affandi answers for your decision' are published only if true on every channel (form, email, WhatsApp, assistant); otherwise fall back to the current controlled suitability sentence.
Replace 'Decided it fits? Let's talk about your intake.' with 'Discuss which route fits your purpose.' on the comparison page.
Day-3 email that answers all three fit questions inline with the boundary sentence and the verbatim fee and scholarship sentences present, so the email is complete without a click.

heroPreference.why: From a compliance lens the home hero is the highest-exposure surface, and progress-first's is the safest of the three once one word is fixed. The H1 'From carrying the decision alone to leading it.' is an act the participant performs during the six months, names no product, count or outcome, and could be read back by a graduate as 'that is what I did'. Its three supporting lines carry the live-issue activity, the structure facts, the CMI Certificate of Recognition with the not-an-MQA-degree boundary, the separate optional Chartered Manager route and 'An enquiry does not commit you to enrol or pay.' in the same viewport, so the gown-and-cap image, 'awarded' and 'graduates' never render without the boundary. It keeps CTA_LABELS.guide unchanged and adds a purpose line, which is the best conversion device of the three. Required fix before use: the purpose line must end 'then decide whether to arrange a conversation', removing 'deserves' from the sentence that names the fee and the scholarship; all literals interpolate constants and 'in 3 scheduled sessions' becomes 'across 3 scheduled sessions'. rjtbd-first's hero is rejected for the good-thing panel ('A faster route', 'A fee to minimise') and a lede whose first nouns are 'Credential, fee and schedule'; service-first's 'Decide well for the people who depend on you.' carries a shaming reading the proposal itself flags and needs an A/B before it can lead the site.
